option_a_native_joint_space.reasoning: DINOv2 (vision-only) and Multilingual-E5 / MiniLM (text-only) have no shared training or joint space. Equal dimensions (384) do not denote compatible vector manifolds.

option_b_learned_alignment.reasoning: No paired visual-text dataset exists in the repository. Per project policy (D7 and Rule 4), alignment training cannot be fabricated without verified paired data.

option_c_separate_spaces_symbolic_fusion.reasoning: Enforces strict vector isolation. Direct cross-modal vector comparison raises IncompatibleSpaceError. Cross-modal association relies on symbolic matching of video hash, timestamp, bounding box, class, and event provenance.

prerequisites_for_revisiting_learned_ali: Independent paired visual-text dataset across multiple distinct video sources
Source-level train/validation/test split with zero leakage
Bidirectional retrieval Recall@5 exceeding random baseline
